data.name: Nuvio
data.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
data.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.
data.versionDescription:
Nuvio 0.5.10 | nuvio-0.5.10-full-release

- [feat(ios): add native PiP with existing MPV VideoToolbox frames (#2248)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2248) @WhiteGiso  
- [Fix dismissed shows staying hidden after marking episodes watched (#2244)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2244) @Laskco  
- [Add non-AI Subtitle AutoSync for mobile add-on subtitles (#2143)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2143) @DavidVamaiotu  
- [fix(i18n): localize generic Episode N titles like TV (#2241)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2241) @blueocean2308  
- [ fix next episode card timing and prefetch with heuristic post-credits (#2238)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2238) @skoruppa  
- [Optimize custom poster URL resolving performance (#2239)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2239) @halibiram  
- [fix: In Poster Card Style settings screen one toggle get bigger then other and pushed out of the screen safe area. (#2219)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2219) @AdityasahuX07
